skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Emerald Holiday
skins.content: Ambience Synesthesia Tailor-Provided/Emerald Holiday. Reed's plain outfit during downtime. Lyrics have limits, and manuscripts have deadlines, but all that's still far, far away. They're no worry; in the comfort of the afternoon sun, finishing your glass of juice comes first.
skins.quote: Words scatter into the air, sticking by the leaves and landing in her glass. After Reed gathers them all up, only then can she put them together throughout the days and the nights.
